progression.label: Progression
progression.help: Chords separated by spaces. Add :N for N beats (default 4), e.g. Am Dm7 G7:2 C/G:2
progression.invalid: Not recognised: {{tokens}}. Try for example C, Am, G7, Cmaj7, Bm7b5, Esus4, C/G.
progression.empty: Type at least one chord, for example: C G Am F

stage.label: Voice lines of the chord progression. Drag a line up or down to change that note.
stage.hint: Drag a line to change a note · Drag the background or use the wheel to move in time · Ctrl+wheel to zoom · Click a chord to hear it

discardEdits.detail: Changing the progression creates new voices and discards the notes you edited by hand. You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.

updates.title: Updates
updates.auto: Check for updates automatically at startup
updates.upToDateStable: You are on the latest stable version.
updates.upToDateTesting: You are on the latest version, including test builds.
updates.testingAvailable: There is no newer stable version, but there is a test build (choose the Testing channel): {{version}}
updates.noReleases: No releases have been published yet.
updates.notSet: The update repository is not set (expected owner/name).
updates.notFound: The update repository did not respond (it is private, or the name is wrong): {{repo}}
updates.rateLimited: GitHub asked to wait (rate limit). Try again later.
updates.badResponse: GitHub sent a response that could not be read.
updates.mismatch: The downloaded file does not match the published SHA-256. It will not be installed.
updates.hashUnreadable: The published SHA-256 could not be read. The update will not be installed.
updates.installNote: AlmaSound closes and the installer opens. Your settings are kept.
updates.pageNote: There is no installer for this system: the release page opens in your browser.

simple.empty: Click the chords above to build your progression.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: The report holds versions, settings, the last attempts and the last log lines, with secrets removed. Attach it to your bug report.
diagnostics.noLogFile: No log file could be opened; the lines above are kept in memory only.
diagnostics.saveFailed: Could not save the report: {{error}}. Try “Save to…” or “Copy report”.

fatal.loadTitle: The window could not be loaded
fatal.crashDetail: You can reload it. To report the problem, open Help → Diagnostics and save the report (log: {{path}}).
fatal.noWindow: AlmaSound started but could not draw its window. Close it and start it again: it will use software rendering (you can also start it with --software).
fatal.noWindowSafe: AlmaSound could not draw its window, even with software rendering. Run diagnostics.bat (in the AlmaSound folder or the Start menu) and send diagnostics.txt.
